completion.raw_text:
SELECT 
  tf.block_hash, 
  tf.block_number, 
  tf.block_timestamp, 
  tf.from_address, 
  tf.to_address, 
  tf.token_address, 
  tf.normalized_amount, 
  tf.value_cast_valid, 
  tf.value_raw, 
  tf.is_erc20, 
  tf.is_erc721, 
  c.category, 
  c.is_erc20 as is_erc20_contract, 
  c.is_erc721 as is_erc721_contract 
FROM 
  token_transfer_facts tf 
  JOIN contract_dimension c ON tf.token_address = c.address 
WHERE 
  tf.end_date = '2026-06-05' 
  AND tf.start_date = '2026-06-04'
